text:
tyler_sales: Handoff: Aegis Medical pilot signed. PO in SF, go-live target 2025-05-12. Main asks: SSO (SAML), PHI-safe private control plane or dedicated capacity, sustained ~3 rps during clinic hours (~25k tokens/day). Contact: emily@aegis.com. Deck: https://tiny.red/aegis-pilot-deck

maria_cs: Thanks — I'll own onboarding. Quick Qs: 1) Dedicated GPUs or private control plane sufficient? 2) Any other compliance besides BAA?

tyler_sales: They need a signed BAA + audit logs. Prefer private control plane in us-east-1. Open to dedicated if cost fits. No custom model training, want Redwood models but private control plane.

maria_cs: Got it. @noah_support can you triage infra reqs? @aj_eng any concerns with private control plane + SAML? I'll schedule kickoff with customer.

noah_support: Creating infra ticket. Need SAML metadata and customer VPC CIDR for peering. ETA to provision env: ~3 business days after receiving details.

aj_eng: Flag: to hit 99.9 latency SLO we may need a dedicated pool during business hours. Need expected concurrent sessions + avg tokens/session to size.

tyler_sales: Estimate: peak 12 concurrent sessions, avg 400 tokens/session. Peak window 9am-5pm ET.

maria_cs: Action owners: CS: maria_cs (onboarding + SSO), Support: noah_support (infra + tickets), Eng: aj_eng (capacity/latency), Security: sam_security (BAA/PHI review). I'll assemble a checklist.

maria_cs: Checklist snippet:
```
- SAML metadata (emily@aegis)
- BAA signed
- VPC peering CIDR
- Dedicated pool sizing
- Test prompts + eval set
- Rollout plan: canary -> full
```

sam_security: I need to review their DPA/BAA wording — ping me the doc. HSM for keys will be required; adds ~2-4 days.

tyler_sales: Sharing docs with customer (they're looped): https://drive.google.com/aegis/handshake. I'll ask them for SAML metadata by EOD.

deploy-bot: ticket CS-1129 created by noah_support - infra.provision.vpc

noah_support: Placing placeholder invite for tech kickoff Thu 2025-05-01 11:00am ET. @maria_cs please confirm availability.

maria_cs: :thumbsup: Confirmed. Will run kickoff and capture action items; follow-up after provisioning to validate canary plan.

aj_eng: I'll run a perf sim once model choice is locked. Likely q8 quantization to control cost, will validate quality on their eval set.

tyler_sales: Renewal risk: medium. They signed a 6-month pilot with expansion potential. Biggest risks are latency and PHI/compliance delays. Sales will monitor and escalate if needed.

maria_cs: Noted. I'll add a health flag and weekly sync cadence. If infra or security blockers extend >5 business days, escalate to VP CRO.

tyler_sales: Thanks team — I'll update the customer and close the loop on incoming artifacts.
